# Declarations

## Authors' contributions

```{r author-contributions, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
.drop_author_title <- function(x)gsub(",.*$", "", x)
.initials <- function(x)gsub("\\W*\\b(\\w)\\w*", "\\1", x)
authors <- unlist(rmarkdown::metadata$author, recursive = FALSE)

roles <- lapply(authors, "[[", "role")
nn <- lengths(roles)
ctbs <- data.frame(
    author = rep(names(roles), nn),
    contribution = unlist(roles),
    row.names = seq_len(sum(nn))
)
ctbs <- ctbs[order(ctbs$contribution, ctbs$author),]
l <- split(.initials(.drop_author_title(ctbs$author)), ctbs$contribution)
nms <- names(l)
actbs <- character(length(l))
## lapply/mapply is not working with .cli_text, even `force` doesn't help
for (i in seq_along(l)) {
    nm <- nms[i]
    txt <- l[[i]]
    actbs[i] <- paste0(nm, ": ", .cli_text("{txt}"), collapse = "; ")
}
cat(paste0(actbs, collapse = "; "), ".", sep = "")
```

## Disclosure of Delegation to Generative AI

The authors declare the use of generative AI in the research and writing process. According to the GAIDeT taxonomy (2025), the following tasks were delegated to GAI tools under full human supervision:

- Visualization
- Proofreading and editing

- Reformatting

The GAI tool used was: Claude Opus 5 (Claude Code Version 2.1.246; Anthropic, San Francisco, CA, USA).
Responsibility for the final manuscript lies entirely with the authors.
GAI tools are not listed as authors and do not bear responsibility for the final outcomes.
Declaration submitted by: Sebastian Gibb

## Data availability

The data generated and analysed in this study
and the code that produced the results reported here
are available at https://github.com/umg-minai/vct-or-mc [@vctormcdata].

## Role of the manufacturer

ZeoSys Medical GmbH (Luckenwalde, Germany) manufactures the CONTRAfluran^TM^ canisters
and the SENSOfluran indicator units evaluated in this study.
The canisters were sent to the company after study completion.
The company weighed them, performed the thermal desorption
and reported the recovered mass of sevoflurane.
The company also specified the minimum batch size of 80 canisters.
Beyond this it had no role in the design or conduct of the study,
took no part in the analysis
and did not review or comment on the manuscript before submission.

## Declaration of interests

```{r declaration-of-interests, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
cois <- vapply(authors, "[[", "competing_interest", FUN.VALUE = NA_character_)
is_none <- cois == "none"

if (all(is_none)) {
    cat("The authors declare that they have no conflict of interest.")
} else {
    nms_coi <- .initials(.drop_author_title(names(cois)))
    cat(paste(nms_coi[!is_none], cois[!is_none], collapse = "; "),
        " The remaining authors declare that they have no conflict of interest.",
        sep = "")
}
```
